IGUI_PhunServer2_One: Server will restart in one minute
IGUI_PhunServer2_NoAccess: You have insufficient access for this command
IGUI_PhunServer2_RestartCancelled: The pending restart has been cancelled
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_Usage: Usage: /diag  OR  /diag x y [z]  OR  /diag health
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_HealthTitle: Map health: every map in the list, and whether its zones loaded
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_Healthy: No problems found on either side.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_HealthHint: Map health found %1 problem(s) at server start. Press Map health to see them.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_FoldersOk: All %1 Map= entries have a folder.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_NoMapOption: The server has no Map= option to check.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_StaleSave: the client has zones the server does not, for %1 map(s) starting with '%2'. The map files themselves load fine, as the client shows. Most likely the server restored its zones from the save, which was written before these maps were added or gained zones, as happens when a map is added to or extended in an existing world. The boxes above hold one of those zones: press Probe to see it.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_SinglePlayer: Single player: both columns read the same world, so they always agree.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_Differ: %1 field(s) differ between client and server. They are in red.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_Dropped: This cell has %1 rooms and no map buildings: its buildings were dropped when the map list loaded. Expect no roof cutaway and no power indoors. Map health names the cause.
IGUI_PhunServer2_Diag_F_cellUserBuilding: Player-built buildings in this cell (x,y size)
